facts.event: 在废弃教堂熬过冷汤长椅的一夜后，日出前 Evelyn 对 Tris 说“你现在回去也没人知道”，Tris 想到昨天打定的主意和留给母亲的字条，答“No”，理由是“I need answers”。
facts.text: But then I think about the hard knot of purpose that I tied within myself yesterday, when I decided to leave. My note to my mother. I need answers.

facts.event: Evelyn 边走边讲：城里 factionless 分两种，一种蹲空楼、排队领水和救济；六年前几个人决定不再那样活，在五个派系眼皮底下另建一套秩序。
facts.text: “But there’s another kind,” she says. “Six years ago, a few of us decided we didn’t have to live that way. We came together, and started building something better, right under the five factions’ noses.”

facts.event: Evelyn 领她进红砖矮楼 the Rookery，并交代城中共三处安全屋：Rookery、Museum、Conservatory，新来的“stray”先住 Rookery 直到定下自己的行当（trade）。
facts.text: “We have three safe houses in the city: one is the Rookery, one is the Museum, and one is the Conservatory.”

facts.event: 穿过破败门厅后是金饰、彩窗、大理石阶梯的中庭；Evelyn 承认昨夜“冷汤加硬长椅”是她故意用来试探 Tris 是否真心投靠。
facts.text: “I’m sorry for the ‘cold soup and a hard bench’ routine. I needed to make sure you were committed,” she says.

facts.event: Evelyn 把 Tris 交给几周前从 Amity 来的 Rory 带路；Rory 讲行会（Healers 医、Travelers 开火车、Makers 手艺、Foxes 机敏）与三条规矩——别被抓、要有用、无派系——Tris 由此意识到自己站在一个把“无派系”当信条的第六个派系总部。
facts.text: I nod, but what I’m really thinking is that I’m standing in a faction headquarters—a sixth faction, hidden from the others, and the virtue it wraps itself around is “no factions.”

facts.event: 在 Mender 的作坊（满墙衣架、脚踏缝纫机），Tris 背着人脱下 Abnegation 灰外套换上 Dauntless 黑夹克，又拔掉发针散开头发。
facts.text: With a glance over my shoulder to make sure they aren’t watching, I shrug off my Abnegation jacket and pull the black one on. It’s a sturdy material, with a zipper instead of buttons. The sleeves are too long for me, but the rest of it seems to fit.

facts.event: Mender 叫来 Gretchen，让 Tris 依次扮 Erudite、Dauntless 让她猜出身；Gretchen 凭灰鞋先猜 Abnegation，最后说“我们会盯着她”，Mender 承认自己专门向行会推荐“看不出出身”的人。
facts.text: “Some people only look like where they came from, and some people don’t. When I see the ones who don’t, I tell someone. It’s not a big thing.”

facts.event: 早餐时 Rory 把 Tris 介绍给 Colin（Erudite 出身、选 Dauntless 却因腿抽筋没跳上火车）、Cassandra、Miles；Foxes 行会从 Amity 劫粮归来分发赃物，Tris 认定这就是她要找的贼帮——典礼上那枪是从墙上偷的，她要问出谁杀了 Robert、为了什么。
facts.text: At least now I know who I need to talk to. The gun that fired at the Choosing Ceremony was stolen from the wall, and this is a guild of factionless thieves. Maybe one of them knows who killed Robert and why—and what it’s supposed to lead to.

relations: Evelyn 是 factionless 组织者之一，亲自带 Tris 进 Rookery、用一夜苦头试探她的决心；Tris 忘不掉 Evelyn 在 Choosing Ceremony 后持枪指着她。
Rory 是几周前从 Amity 来的 stray，被指派带 Tris 熟悉环境；她因打架且拒绝“break bread”道歉被 Amity 逐出，一心想进 Foxes。
the Mender 是 Rookery 的裁缝/改衣师（Candor 出身，与妹妹 Mae 同来），个子极高、全身深李子色衣饰、每指一枚金戒；他提出收 Tris 当学徒。
Mae 是 Mender 的妹妹，在作坊读书；她说母亲当年骗过了 Candor 的 truth serum，Tris 由此判断其母是 Divergent。
Gretchen 是行会方面的招募眼线，被 Mender 请来“猜派系”，对 Tris 的评价是“We’ll keep an eye on her”。
Colin 是红发男孩，Erudite 出身、选 Dauntless，因腿抽筋没跳上火车而流落到此；Cassandra 因太内敛过不了 Candor 的 full disclosure；Miles 是解不出第一道谜题的 Erudite。
Jove 是 Rookery 的负责人（leader），Tris 只见其分发米袋；Evelyn 与 Foxes 一同出现。
Tris 的母亲 Natalie 给她准备了装罐头的包，并承诺 factionless 的生活“比她想的好”；Tris 留了字条离家，Robert 在 Choosing Ceremony 上被枪杀，Tori 曾告诉她 Divergent 会“destabilize”体制。
numbers: We have three safe houses in the city（三处安全屋：Rookery / Museum / Conservatory）
Six years ago（六年前开始自建组织）
There are only three（规矩只有三条）
groups larger than five（factionless 聚集不得超过五人，哨兵称之为“crowding”）
we’re not allowed in there for another twenty minutes（Foxes 晨会还要二十分钟）
She came here from Amity a few weeks ago（Rory 几周前从 Amity 来）
I’ve been letting you not finish your book for at least five minutes now（Mender 至少五分钟没催 Mae 读书）
They kick you out for one fight（Amity 一次打架就逐人）
the end of the day（Mae 当天要读完那本书）
